notes: GBDT specialist (stack: tuned-catboost + hgb_log + catboost_log) beats floor OOF by 2.7% (1.654 vs 1.700). However, GBDT stability is 0.0/single-split — the specialist scored only one aggregate OOF, not 5-fold per-candidate, making stability unassessable. Residual analysis shows strong heteroscedasticity (corr=0.616): Q4 mean_abs_residual=3.34 vs Q1=0.67 — high-value observations drive error. Linear scored 3.68 (NNLS weight 0.012, near-dead weight). Pred mean=12.73 vs train mean=6.35 (ratio 2.0) is elevated but passes sanity. tune_iter=null in gbdt agent suggests no randomized hyperparameter search was logged.

suggestions.suggestion: Heteroscedasticity corr=0.616 with Q4 mean_abs_residual=3.34 (5x Q1). Apply log1p to the target in the specialist pipeline to compress the right tail and reduce absolute error at high values. The floor already uses _log variants and they outperform raw models.
suggestions.implementation_hint: In feature_pipeline.py / specialist training, train on log1p(target) and predict back via expm1. The floor's lightgbm_log already does this and scores 0.882 OOF — ensure the GBDT specialist's tuned-catboost also uses log1p target consistently.

suggestions.suggestion: GBDT agent reports tune_iter=null — no randomized search budget was consumed. Run at least 30 Optuna/random-search iterations on catboost/LightGBM (learning_rate in [0.01,0.1], num_leaves in [63,255], min_child_samples in [5,50], subsample/colsample in [0.6,1.0]) on canonical 5-folds to replace the default single-configuration run.
suggestions.implementation_hint: Set tune_iter=30 in the gbdt-specialist prompt; use optuna or RandomizedSearchCV with cv=canonical_folds; early_stopping_rounds=50.

suggestions.suggestion: Linear family (NNLS weight 0.012) is near-dead weight. Drop it from next-round NNLS pool to save 854s of training time. The gap vs floor (3.68 vs 1.70) is too large to recover via blending.
suggestions.implementation_hint: Blacklist linear in next round; redirect its wall-clock budget to deeper GBDT search or seed-averaging.

suggestions.suggestion: Prediction mean (12.73) is 2x training mean (6.35) — the test period likely contains higher-rate observations. Add a jurisdiction-level trend feature (target_roll12_mean / target_lag12 ratio or linear slope over last 12 periods per jurisdiction-category) to help the model extrapolate rising trends rather than regressing to mean.
suggestions.implementation_hint: In feature_pipeline.py, per (jurisdiction, overdose_category) group compute slope = polyfit(ordinal_rank[-12:], target[-12:], deg=1)[0] fitted on training data only; join to both train and pred sets.

suggestions.suggestion: The floor stack (lightgbm_log + catboost_log weights 0.455/0.545) scores 0.878 on the floor's internal CV but the canonical OOF is 1.700. Verify the floor stack's OOF was computed on the same canonical 5-folds as specialists to ensure apples-to-apples comparison; the note in ensemble_meta.json acknowledges the protocol difference.
suggestions.implementation_hint: Cross-check floor OOF CSV (oof_floor.csv) against cv_folds.json period assignments; if the floor used a different holdout, re-score floor predictions on canonical fold assignments before NNLS blending.
